_comment: REVERIFY-BANK-1: dated external regulatory facts with no human refresh owner. Per SO #0 (SURVIVES-THE-MAINTAINER), the refresh duty lives in scripts/check-bank-fact-freshness.mjs (derives staleness from each entry's own verified_on, same pattern as data/reg-deadlines.json + check-deadline-freshness.mjs), never in a calendar ritual a human must remember to run.

entries.fact: SIFMA/joint-trades petition to rescind SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05 (cybersecurity incident disclosure) is pending before the SEC; no rescission, denial, or rulemaking action taken.
2026-07-01 remains the latest published effective date for the Federal Reserve Discount Window collateral-margins table; no newer version exists.

IRS Publication 15-T (2026) is the current edition of the federal income tax withholding methods publication; its 2026 Percentage Method tables with Worksheet 1A are what the tool's 2026 tax-year tables follow, and the 2025 edition remains published for the 2025 tax-year selection.
SSA contribution and benefit base is $184,500 for 2026 and $176,100 for 2025, the two tax years the tool supports.

Swift's Standards Releases page lists the November 2026 CBPR+ Usage guidelines (CBPR+ UHB SR2026 final edition released 20 February 2026) with Standards MX Release 2026 live on 14 November 2026, the rule set the tool's CBPR+ validation follows.

SEC Rule 10c-1a covered-securities-loan reporting compliance date is 2028-09-28, set by SEC order 34-104303 (2025-12-03) after the Fifth Circuit remand; the validator's scope notice displays this date.

Regulation CC funds-availability dollar thresholds were inflation-adjusted effective 2025-07-01 (a 21.8% CPI-W increase measured July 2018-July 2023); the calculator's threshold table is pinned to that most recent reset, with the next reset due around 2030.

SEC Rule 10c-1a covered-securities-loan reporting compliance date is 2028-09-28, set by SEC order 34-104303 (2025-12-03) after the Fifth Circuit remand; the readiness diagnostic's scope box displays this date.
NYDFS Part 500 covered-entity annual certification is due by April 15 for the prior calendar year (23 NYCRR 500.17(b)), the filing-deadline math the certification builder computes.
Verification-of-Payee obligations under Regulation (EU) 2024/886 bind non-euro-area payment service providers from 2027-07-09; euro-area PSPs have been bound since 2025-10-09.
FR Y-9C filers are top-tier bank and thrift holding companies with total consolidated assets of $3 billion or more, the panel threshold the page's scope text displays.

France's B2B e-invoicing receive obligation (and large/ETI issuance) went live 2026-09-01, the post-delay date superseding the original 2024-2026 schedule.
